en.choose_cats_info:
Choose up to six cats to take on patrol.
Smaller patrols help cats gain more experience, but larger patrols are safer.
en.help_tooltip: In the Badlands, not every cat can do every type of patrol. Due to its danger and potential for interaction with other Baronies, only Clippers, colts, Regents, heirs, and Barons may patrol the borders. Clippers, Regents, heirs, Barons, colts, and cogs may participate in hunting or training patrols. Including cogs on hunting patrols will increase the amount of prey caught. Any cat can join the doctor for herb gathering.
